summary: In February 2019, two out-of-state men attempted a winter summit of Quandary Peak in deteriorating weather; near the false summit the man in boots turned back, leaving his friend (on snowshoes) to continue. The snowshoer summited ~2:30 p.m. per photos sent to family but did not return; his friend called 911 at ~7:45 p.m. SCRG searched from ~11 p.m., suspended the search ~1 a.m. due to weather, poor visibility and plummeting temperatures, and resumed ~6 a.m. At ~8:10 a.m. dispatch received the man's call with his coordinates; he was located in good spirits, walked part of the way out and was taken the rest of the way by toboggan, out of the field by ~10:30 a.m. He had spent the sub-zero night sleeping on pine boughs out of the wind and revived his dead phone by warming it under his armpit.
notes: Date approximate: February 2019 per SCRG mission coordinator Charles Pitman's "Get Wild: Critical decision making saved a life" Summit Daily column; listed as first of month. Flight for Life was called for an aerial search but was weathered out.
